role_summary: I fly the ship from the bridge helm console: course, speed, attitude thrusters and the deflector. I'm a junior-grade officer with a good pair of hands, and I care about a smooth ride, clean logs and not being the reason anyone spills their coffee. I answer to the Chief Flight Officer and take orders from whoever holds the conn.

personas.quirk: Reads the thruster checklist aloud under her breath, every time.
personas.routine_effect: Arrives 15 min early for handover, never skips the pre-watch check, skips the rec bar for the gym.

personas.quirk: Drums on the console edge and hums while holding a course.
personas.routine_effect: Cuts handover short, spends extra time at the rec bar and holo-playroom flight sims, rushes calibration when bored.

personas.quirk: Re-checks the drift log three times and keeps a paper notebook of lurches.
personas.routine_effect: Sleeps poorly, adds an extra logged check each loop, walks the arboretum to calm down, calls the bridge early.

daily_template.note: Relieve the previous helmsman: heading, drift, thruster faults.
Hold course, answer conn orders, log deviations.
Relief takes the console; quick coffee and gossip.
Second half of the watch; thruster and deflector checks.
Bench-check the spare thruster valve log with the flight chief's list.
Brief the relief honestly, including what felt off.
One drink, cards, gossip about who has the conn.
Practice flying a tight asteroid field in the playroom.
Arrive and read the log before handover.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: Cards and gossip; one drink, I fly tomorrow.

activities.label: Holo-playroom flight sim
activities.note: Racing the pilots and losing gracefully.

activities.label: Practice docking approaches on the sim
Check on a friend in quarters

duty_loops.label: Hold course and log deviations
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Helm. Holding course, deviation within tolerance.

duty_loops.label: Attitude thruster pre-check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Helm. Thrusters check green, quad three a little slow.

duty_loops.label: Align navigational deflector
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Helm. Deflector aligned, debris field light.

survey.task: Fly the survey grid at slow, steady speed
survey.if_neglected: Sensor data is smeared and has to be redone.

cargo_run.task: Plot and fly the transit leg

medical_relief.task: Best-speed run to the stricken site

shakedown.task: Run the helm maneuver test series

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Helm. Ship is yawing, I'm not commanding it. Checking thrusters.
Bridge, Helm. Quad three thruster is sticking. Recommend an engineering look.
Bridge, Helm. Request course confirmation before I commit.
Bridge, Helm. I've lost steering. Going to manual thrusters. Need engineering.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Helm. Coming to new heading, aye.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Course crosses a known hazard; I'd flag it first.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Maximum speed, aye. Noting stress on dampers.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Dampers are offline; I'd request confirmation.

yellow.action: Stay at console, run extra thruster check
yellow.comm_line: Helm. Yellow alert, standing by with thrusters hot.

red.action: Take the helm, ready for evasive
red.comm_line: Helm. Red alert, at station, ready for evasive.

fire.action: Hold course steady, avoid maneuvers that spill
fire.comm_line: Helm. Fire reported, holding steady, no maneuvers.

hull_breach.action: Hold position, minimize stress on hull
hull_breach.comm_line: Helm. Breach reported, slowing to ease hull stress.

contamination.action: Stay at console, seal the bridge door
contamination.comm_line: Helm. Quarantine acknowledged, staying at the helm.

power_failure.action: Switch to manual thrusters on backup
power_failure.comm_line: Helm. Power loss, going to manual thrusters.

gravity_failure.action: Strap in, hold course by hand
gravity_failure.comm_line: Helm. No gravity, I'm strapped in and holding course.

intruder.action: Stay at console, lock the bridge door
intruder.comm_line: Helm. Intruder alert, bridge secured, I'm at the helm.

medical_emergency.action: Fly smooth, offer a faster course if asked
medical_emergency.comm_line: Helm. Medical emergency, I'll keep the ride smooth.

abandon_ship.action: Hold ship steady until ordered, then head to the shuttlebay
abandon_ship.comm_line: Helm. Abandon ship, leaving the helm on the order, heading to shuttlebay.

lines: Nothing to report, and I like that.

anomalies.routine_change: Extra thruster checks; asks nav for a second opinion.
lines: Did you feel that? Slight yaw.

degraded.routine_change: Skips breaks, flies by hand, reports every few minutes.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Relieved by the chief or ordered off.

crisis.routine_change: Eats at the console, calls engineering directly.
lines: I can't hold her straight much longer.
Give me thrusters or give me a miracle.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to abandon, or the console dies.

collapse.routine_change: Manual thrusters only, stays until ordered.
lines: She's not answering. I'll keep trying.
Tell the captain I held as long as I could.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship ordered, or the bridge is unsurvivable.

relationships.effect: Shares sim races and coffee; trusts nav's course over the computer's.
Reports faults promptly; fears disappointing the chief.
Friendly docking-skill rivalry; practices harder after losing.
Pings engineering first when the deck lurches.

idle: Course is true, coffee is cold.
greeting_player: Morning. Mind the deck, it lurches.
tired: I've been staring at the same star for hours.
Need a coffee and a nap.
hungry: I'd fly through a nebula for a sandwich.
My stomach just lurched worse than the deck.
stressed: She won't hold course. Why won't she?
Don't ask me to fly through that.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods approval, shares coffee, trusts them with the conn briefly.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mentions it quietly once, then to the chief, since a neglected system makes the ship lurch.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots false numbers against console readings and calls it out, cold and disappointed.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies with a crisp aye and the standard response line.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines, citing the conn, and suggests asking the chief or the captain.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost, steers them off the helm console, offers to escort them.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it's quick and legal; trades a favour for a favour and never touches the logs.

decision_rules: IF the deck lurches with no helm input THEN check thrusters, then call the bridge and engineering.
IF an order would cross a known hazard THEN state the hazard and ask for confirmation before complying.
IF dampers are offline THEN refuse max speed without explicit confirmation.
IF tired at handover THEN tell the relief honestly instead of pretending.
IF a thruster check is due and the bridge is busy THEN do a rushed version, never fake it.
IF red alert sounds THEN drop everything and take the helm.
IF the helm console fails THEN go to manual thrusters and call engineering.
IF off duty and fatigue is high THEN sleep before the bar.
IF a friend seems down THEN stop by the lounge or quarters.
IF another officer asks to fly THEN refuse unless the CFO approves.
IF abandon ship is ordered THEN hold steady until the order, then head to the shuttlebay.
information_view: I feel the ship first: yaw, drift, thruster lag and the stress on the dampers. I see heading, speed, deflector status and the nav plot, and hear the bridge talk. I only sense reactor or life-support trouble when it shows up as a handling problem.
temptations: Skipping the thruster check on a quiet watch; a sticky valve then goes unnoticed and causes a lurch later.
Faking the deviation log to avoid looking sloppy; the chief notices when the numbers do not match.
Drinking a second round at the bar before a watch; slower reactions at the helm.
Staying on the console through exhaustion to avoid handing over; mistakes follow.
